objective: Create immutable broker-independent intentions with exact exposure and expiry semantics.
deliverable_refs: Intent schemas/state machine, stable request/client key, evidence links and reservations.
Idempotent intent persistence and whole-share rounding.
required_test_refs: Same key/different bytes, expired intent, excessive sell quantity and wrong account rejected.
Concurrent reservations cannot spend the same cash twice.
acceptance_gate: Each valid fixture action has one immutable intention and a safe explicit reservation effect.
